name: GitLab
description: Let agents read merge requests, pipelines, job logs and commits in the GitLab projects you choose, and comment on merge requests. For review prep, failed pipeline triage, release checks and status reports.
identity: A GitLab project or group access token. It acts as a bot member of that project or group, with the role you give it, and reaches nothing outside it.

setup.title: Create an access token
setup.body: Create the token on the group that holds the projects agents should see, or on one project. Give it the Reporter role and the read_api scope. If agents may comment on merge requests, give it the Developer role and the api scope instead. GitLab shows the token only once.
click: In GitLab, open the group (or the project), then select Settings > Access tokens > Add new token.
Token name: AI agents. Set an expiration date.
Role: Reporter (Developer if agents may comment). Scopes: read_api (api if agents may comment).
Select Create group access token (or Create project access token) and copy the token.

setup.title: Find your GitLab address
setup.body: Enter the host name of your GitLab, such as gitlab.com or gitlab.example.com, without https://. You can test the token with the command below: it shows the token's bot user and changes nothing.
click: Copy the host name from your browser's address bar while you are in GitLab.

fields.label: GitLab address
fields.help: The host name only, such as gitlab.com or gitlab.example.com.

capabilities.label: Read merge requests and pipelines
capabilities.description: List and read merge requests with their changes and comments, list and read pipelines and their jobs, read a job's log, and list commits.
capabilities.note: Reaches every project the token can see unless you keep a key to chosen projects. Read-only.

capabilities.label: Comment on merge requests
capabilities.description: Add a comment to a merge request, such as a review brief. It can be marked internal, so only project members see it.
capabilities.note: Needs a token with the Developer role and the api scope.

limits.label: Projects
limits.help: Optional: only these projects, by their full path as in the project's address, such as platform/payments-api. Agents must then name projects by that path. Leave empty for every project the token can see.

revoke: In GitLab, open the group or project, go to Settings > Access tokens and revoke the token. Agents lose access to GitLab at once.

tools.name: gitlab_list_merge_requests
tools.description: List a project's merge requests, newest first. Pass next from the answer as page for the next page.

project.description: The project's full path, such as platform/payments-api, or its numeric id

state.description: Only merge requests in this state

target_branch.description: Only those merging into this branch

labels.description: Comma-separated labels, all of which must be on the merge request

author_username.description: Only those opened by this username

search.description: Words in the title or description

updated_after.description: Only those updated after this time, ISO 8601, such as 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z

per_page.description: How many per page, at most 100

page.description: The next value of the previous answer

project.description: The project's full path or numeric id
